title: iyakki dev usb brings developer mode up over one USB-C cable between t

clauses.text: iyakki dev usb brings developer mode up over one USB-C cable between two computers

steps.do: Connect two computers with one USB-C cable and run iyakki dev usb check, then pair.
steps.expect: The seven steps turn green one by one and the pair works; if not, note which step stops (KI-992 is open).
